findings.evidenceJa: 体の調子もいいし
findings.governingReading: his body feels well or is in good condition
findings.explanation: A positive recovery assessment becomes only the absence of sickness.

findings.highlight: I’ll go to the shopping district
findings.evidenceJa: サッと商店街まで行って、サッと帰ってくればいい
findings.governingReading: he need only dash to the shopping district and dash back
findings.explanation: Both speed and the planned immediate return disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 夕食の買い出し
findings.governingReading: shopping for dinner
findings.explanation: The household errand is again expressed as buying unspecified “stuff.”

findings.highlight: I don’t want to interrupt them
findings.evidenceJa: せっかくいい雰囲気なんだから邪魔するのもなんだし
findings.governingReading: since they have managed to create such a good atmosphere, it would be a shame to disturb them
findings.explanation: Shirou’s appreciation of Sakura and Saber’s rapport is reduced to generic reluctance to interrupt.

findings.highlight: Going to buy stuff for dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 夕飯のおかずを買ってくる
findings.governingReading: going to buy side dishes or ingredients for dinner
findings.explanation: The note again replaces a plausible specific errand with unspecified “stuff.”

findings.highlight: if I buy them some snacks
findings.evidenceJa: 帰りに三時のおやつを買ってくれば
findings.governingReading: if he buys a three-o’clock snack on the way back
findings.explanation: The return trip and culturally specific snack time are omitted.

findings.highlight: they won’t get mad at me
findings.evidenceJa: 二人のカミナリも落ちないだろう
findings.governingReading: then the two will probably not bring their thunder down on him
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic metaphor for the women’s scolding becomes plain anger.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s going to be staying over for a while
findings.evidenceJa: 桜が泊まるようになったんだから
findings.governingReading: now that Sakura has begun staying over
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “for a while,” assigning a duration the narration does not specify.

findings.highlight: maybe I’ll make some meat for dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 肉料理をメインにしてみるか
findings.governingReading: perhaps make a meat dish the main course
findings.explanation: The dinner plan loses both the dish category and its role as the meal’s centerpiece.

findings.evidenceJa: 意気揚揚と帰還しかけた足が止まる
findings.governingReading: his buoyant homeward stride comes to a halt
findings.explanation: The English keeps only an awkward stop and drops Shirou’s cheerful momentum toward home.

findings.highlight: I ready myself while the girl just stands there and smiles
findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に身構える俺と、にこやかにこちらを見つめる少女
findings.governingReading: Shirou reflexively takes guard opposite a girl smiling warmly at him
findings.explanation: The physical contrast remains but loses his reflexive urgency and her directed, genial gaze.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺気というか、敵意がまったく感じられない
findings.governingReading: he senses neither killing intent nor hostility from her
findings.explanation: mirror moon collapses the stronger and weaker threat signals into generic hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に嬉しそうな笑顔
findings.governingReading: a smile that looks genuinely delighted
findings.explanation: Size replaces the sincerity and emotion Shirou reads in Illya’s relief.

findings.evidenceJa: 一刀のもとに斬り伏せた怪物
findings.governingReading: the monster who cut him down with a single stroke
findings.explanation: A decisive near-fatal defeat becomes an unspecified wound.

findings.evidenceJa: 古い魔道の家系
findings.governingReading: an ancient lineage of the path of magecraft
findings.explanation: The family’s antiquity and formal magical tradition disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争の発端を担った
findings.governingReading: bore responsibility for the Holy Grail War’s origin
findings.explanation: A historical role in the war’s inception becomes the blunt claim that the family started the present war.

findings.highlight: I blurt out her name without knowing what it means
findings.evidenceJa: それがどんな意味を持つのかも知らないまま、少女の名を口にしてしまった
findings.governingReading: he speaks the girl’s name without knowing what significance that act carries
findings.explanation: “What it means” is left vague enough to sound like lexical ignorance rather than the relational significance of using Illya’s name.

findings.evidenceJa: あいや、違った
findings.governingReading: Ah—no, that was wrong
findings.explanation: mirror moon fuses the interjection and apology into malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: 反射的に頭を下げる
findings.governingReading: he reflexively bows his head
findings.explanation: A physical, involuntary gesture becomes only the speech act it implies.

findings.highlight: that sad look on her face
findings.evidenceJa: 今にも泣きそうな顔
findings.governingReading: a face on the verge of tears
findings.explanation: Immediate vulnerability becomes generic sadness.

findings.highlight: The girl is glaring at me, maybe because I shortened her name.
findings.governingReading: Illya remains silent while Shirou guesses aloud that he has offended her
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents a glare and supplies Shirou’s name-shortening theory as narration before he has established why she reacted.

findings.highlight: I didn’t mean to make you mad
findings.evidenceJa: 悪気はなかったんだ
findings.governingReading: he meant no harm
findings.explanation: The English adds anger as the confirmed effect of Shirou’s mistake.

findings.evidenceJa: 不思議な発音するんだね
findings.governingReading: you pronounce it strangely
findings.explanation: Illya comments on Shirou’s pronunciation; mirror moon changes the object of strangeness to his name.

findings.highlight: No. Emiya is my last name
findings.evidenceJa: 今の発音だと『笑み社』じゃないか
findings.governingReading: with that pronunciation it becomes “Emi-yashiro,” a smiling shrine or company
findings.explanation: The scene’s explicit missegmentation and written pun are deleted.

findings.evidenceJa: 発音があまりにもキテレツだった為、ついつっこみを入れてしまった
findings.governingReading: her pronunciation is so bizarre that he reflexively delivers a comic correction
findings.explanation: A performed comic retort becomes neutral correction.

findings.evidenceJa: またも目を白黒させる
findings.governingReading: her eyes dart again in bewildered surprise
findings.explanation: The repeated visual reaction becomes generic immobility and surprise.

findings.highlight: It’s too late to take it back, even if I wanted to
findings.evidenceJa: しまった、と思ったところで遅い
findings.governingReading: it is too late by the time he realizes he has blundered
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents ambivalence about retracting the correction and drops the self-recognized mistake.

findings.highlight: I try to shake her off
findings.evidenceJa: ぶんぶん、と腕を振り回す
findings.governingReading: he swings his arm wildly back and forth
findings.explanation: The broad comic motion is narrowed to its inferred purpose.

findings.evidenceJa: ご近所のおばさまたち
findings.governingReading: the neighborhood ladies
findings.explanation: A specific imagined gossip network becomes all nearby residents.

findings.evidenceJa: 良からぬ噂を立てられかねない
findings.governingReading: may start unsavory rumors about him
findings.explanation: Plural socially compromising gossip becomes one generically negative rumor.

findings.highlight: Do you want to fight me right now
findings.evidenceJa: こんなまっ昼間からやりあおうってハラか
findings.governingReading: does she intend to fight starting in broad daylight
findings.explanation: The time-of-day violation motivating Shirou’s suspicion disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: うん、なにシロウ！
findings.governingReading: Yes—what is it, Shirou?
findings.explanation: Added punctuation makes Illya sound startled or confrontational rather than cheerfully attentive.

findings.evidenceJa: この前とイメージ違うぞ
findings.governingReading: his image or impression of her differs from before
findings.explanation: A change in Shirou’s perception becomes a claim that Illya herself has changed.

findings.evidenceJa: 笑顔の質が違う
findings.governingReading: the quality of her smile is different
findings.explanation: The exact basis of Shirou’s uncertainty is removed.

findings.evidenceJa: その視線だけで
findings.governingReading: from that look alone
findings.explanation: A neutral but terrifying gaze is made overtly hostile.

findings.highlight: sends a chill down my spine
findings.evidenceJa: 正直背筋が総毛だった
findings.governingReading: honestly makes every hair along his spine stand on end
findings.explanation: The bodily extremity of Shirou’s fear is reduced to a conventional chill.

findings.highlight: she can also become the ruthless Master
findings.evidenceJa: 冷酷なマスターの貌になる
findings.governingReading: her expression turns into the visage of a ruthless Master
findings.explanation: A facial transformation in bearing becomes an ontological shift into “the” Master.

findings.highlight: I don’t mind going ahead with my plans
findings.evidenceJa: 予定がちょっと早まるだけ
findings.governingReading: it would only move her plans forward a little
findings.explanation: Illya’s cold statement of timing becomes another expression of willingness and loses “only” and the limited acceleration.

findings.evidenceJa: コウエイに思ってよね
findings.governingReading: you should consider it an honor
findings.explanation: Illya’s proud demand that Shirou feel honored becomes ordinary gratitude.

findings.evidenceJa: 得意げにイリヤは笑う
findings.governingReading: Illya smiles proudly
findings.explanation: A visible smug smile becomes awkward narration of an inflated internal state.

findings.highlight: Every time I think she turns into a cruel Master, she returns to being the innocent girl
findings.evidenceJa: 冷酷なマスターになったかと思えば、すぐに無邪気な少女に戻ってしまう
findings.governingReading: just when he thinks she has become a ruthless Master, she immediately returns to an innocent girl
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “every time,” making a local rapid switch sound like an established repeated cycle.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what she means by “all this time”
findings.evidenceJa: 何が“それぐらい”なのかわからない
findings.governingReading: he does not know what her “that much” refers to
findings.explanation: The English points Shirou’s confusion at how long she waited instead of Illya’s claim that she deserves at least this conversation.

findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐに俺の顔を見上げてくる
findings.governingReading: looks straight up into his face
findings.explanation: The upward child-adult staging becomes symmetrical eye contact.

findings.evidenceJa: 全力でイリヤの申し出を拒否するだろう
findings.governingReading: Saber would reject Illya’s offer with all her force
findings.explanation: Saber’s categorical, forceful refusal becomes mere clarity of objection.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺もイリヤとは会って話がしたかった
findings.governingReading: he too had wanted to meet Illya and talk with her
findings.explanation: The English leaves both the desired action and its personal object implicit, weakening Shirou’s reciprocal admission.

findings.evidenceJa: 舞うように走り出す
findings.governingReading: Illya sets off running as though dancing
findings.explanation: Her exuberant, weightless movement disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: おいていっちゃうからね、シロウ
findings.governingReading: I will leave you behind, Shirou
findings.explanation: Illya’s newly claimed familiar use of his name is omitted from the playful threat.

findings.highlight: Well, I guess it can’t be helped
findings.evidenceJa: ま、なるようになるよな
findings.governingReading: well, things will work themselves out somehow
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative optimism becomes resignation.

findings.highlight: I accept this event and follow after Illya
findings.evidenceJa: 観念してイリヤの後を追いかける
findings.governingReading: resigning himself, he runs after Illya
findings.explanation: An idiomatic surrender to the situation becomes unnatural abstract acceptance.

findings.highlight: I should treat her like a normal girl
findings.evidenceJa: 一人の少女として向き合わないと
findings.governingReading: he must face her as an individual girl
findings.explanation: The source contrasts personhood with role; “normal” introduces a judgment about Illya’s abnormality.

findings.evidenceJa: それに寂しさを覚えながら
findings.governingReading: feeling loneliness at the absence of children
findings.explanation: A reaction located in Shirou becomes an objective property of the park.

findings.evidenceJa: この理解不能のお嬢さん
findings.governingReading: this incomprehensible young lady
findings.explanation: Shirou’s comic description of Illya disappears.

findings.highlight: How do I respond to that?
findings.evidenceJa: どうつっこむべきか
findings.governingReading: how should he deliver the necessary comic retort
findings.explanation: The specific comedy role is generalized to any response.

findings.highlight: why do you say you have no business with me
findings.evidenceJa: なんで用件がないんだよ
findings.governingReading: why does she have no matter or purpose to discuss
findings.explanation: The English adds Shirou as the object of “business,” giving the exchange a transactional tone.

findings.highlight: Will you promise me you won’t get mad
findings.evidenceJa: なに訊いても怒らない？
findings.governingReading: will he refrain from getting angry whatever she asks
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a promise Illya does not explicitly demand.

findings.evidenceJa: 大人な対応を努力する
findings.governingReading: he will make an effort to respond as an adult
findings.explanation: A commitment to handle her question maturely becomes performance of a mature persona.

findings.evidenceJa: ぶっ！
findings.governingReading: an explosive spit-take or choking sound
findings.explanation: The physical comic reaction becomes a lexical shout.

findings.evidenceJa: 人をぶった斬っておいて
findings.governingReading: after cutting a person down
findings.explanation: The violent act motivating Shirou’s disbelief is generalized to an attack.

findings.highlight: Illya quivers up and shuts up
findings.evidenceJa: びくり、と肩を震わせてイリヤは黙り込む
findings.governingReading: Illya’s shoulders jerk in a startle and she falls silent
findings.explanation: The physical reaction is mistranslated into malformed English and the wounded withdrawal is coarsened.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why, but I’m not mad
findings.evidenceJa: 自分でもどうかと思うけど、怒ってない
findings.governingReading: he himself thinks it questionable or strange, but he is not angry
findings.explanation: Shirou judges his own lack of anger; mirror moon makes its cause merely unknown.

findings.highlight: She doesn’t feel dangerous to me
findings.evidenceJa: 今のイリヤには敵意がない
findings.governingReading: the Illya before him now bears no hostility
findings.explanation: An observable absence of hostile intent becomes Shirou’s subjective sense of safety.

findings.highlight: I should stop thinking like a Master
findings.evidenceJa: 無理にマスターである必要はない
findings.governingReading: there is no need to force himself to be a Master
findings.explanation: The source relaxes a role under present conditions; the English frames his Master perspective as something he should cease.

findings.highlight: I guess I’ll have to talk with her, just like she wants
findings.evidenceJa: こうして捕まってしまった以上、イリヤが望むようにのんびり話でもするとしよう
findings.governingReading: now that she has caught him, he decides to relax and talk as she wishes
findings.explanation: mirror moon retains obligation but drops the playful capture metaphor, leisure, and Shirou’s active decision.

findings.evidenceJa: 一時間ほど続いたと思う
findings.governingReading: he thinks it continued for roughly an hour
findings.explanation: Approximation and retrospective uncertainty become exact present-tense duration.

findings.highlight: Illya listens to my ordinary stories and meaningless talks
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは喜んで聞いていた
findings.governingReading: Illya listened with delight
findings.explanation: The emotion that gives the ordinary conversation its poignancy disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: なんの意味もない話、ありきたりの出来事
findings.governingReading: talk with no purpose and commonplace events
findings.explanation: The English swaps the modifiers, calling the talk meaningless and the stories ordinary rather than distinguishing purposeless conversation from ordinary events.

findings.highlight: she has no doubt in that fact
findings.evidenceJa: マスターである自分を躊躇わない事
findings.governingReading: she does not hesitate over herself as a Master
findings.explanation: Illya’s lack of moral or emotional hesitation becomes mere certainty that she holds the role.

findings.highlight: as a result of their thousand-year-old history
findings.evidenceJa: 千年の執念の果てに
findings.governingReading: at the end of a thousand years of obsession or tenacity
findings.explanation: The Einzberns’ defining fixation becomes neutral institutional age.

findings.highlight: I have to ask her this
findings.evidenceJa: この問いだけは、口にしなければならなかった
findings.governingReading: this question alone had to be put into words
findings.explanation: The English preserves necessity but drops the exclusivity and the emphasis on finally voicing it.

findings.evidenceJa: 時間が止まる
findings.governingReading: time stops
findings.explanation: A rupture in their shared time becomes an atmospheric cliché.

findings.evidenceJa: 今までの時間が消え去ってしまうほどの、無感情な沈黙
findings.governingReading: an emotionless silence powerful enough to erase all the time they have shared until now
findings.explanation: The defining consequence of Illya’s withdrawal—the apparent annihilation of the preceding intimacy—is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: そろそろ夕暮れだね
findings.governingReading: it is nearly twilight
findings.explanation: The precise threshold that changes their relationship back to enemies becomes generic lateness.

findings.evidenceJa: 無邪気な少女のまま、ばいばい、と別れを告げる
findings.governingReading: still an innocent girl, Illya says “bye-bye”
findings.explanation: Her maintained childlike mode and spoken farewell are reduced to a gesture.

findings.highlight: Can I talk with you again
findings.evidenceJa: また会えるかな
findings.governingReading: might I see you again
findings.explanation: Shirou asks for another meeting; the English narrows it to conversation.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしはそうでもないんだけど
findings.governingReading: it is not as though she particularly wants to, she claims coyly
findings.explanation: Illya’s attempt to minimize her own desire is omitted.

findings.highlight: Don’t expect too much and keep waiting
findings.evidenceJa: 期待しないで待っててね
findings.governingReading: wait for her without expecting anything
findings.explanation: A deliberately noncommittal invitation becomes permission for limited expectation.

findings.evidenceJa: 知ってる人だった
findings.governingReading: he was someone she knew
findings.explanation: Personal acquaintance becomes merely knowing about Kiritsugu.

findings.highlight: I was given birth to this world to win the Holy Grail War. My goal is to kill you and Kiritsugu.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが生まれた理由は聖杯戦争に勝つことだけど。イリヤの目的は、キリツグとシロウを殺す事
findings.governingReading: winning the Grail War is the reason she was born, but Illya’s own purpose is killing Kiritsugu and Shirou
findings.explanation: The English broadly conveys both aims but loses the ruby-backed shift from imposed birth function to Illya’s personally named purpose.

findings.evidenceJa: 去っていく足音
findings.governingReading: the sound of departing footsteps
findings.explanation: An auditory, distancing transition becomes a visually asserted sprint.
